visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a medium shot of a young woman with two hair buns sitting on a gray rug in a living room, leaning against a gray sofa and reading a large vintage-looking book. A hand reaches into the frame from the bottom left, holding two AA batteries (one blue/gold and one silver/gold). (2) Close-up on the woman's hands over a gray checkered tablecloth. She holds the batteries vertically and drops them; one stands upright while the other tips over. (3) She points at the upright battery, looking curious and smiling, then looks back at the camera. (4) She repeatedly drops the batteries on the table to observe how they land. At one point, she uses her finger to manually stand a fallen battery back up. (5) Close-up shots of her face show varied expressions of surprise and realization as she talks to the camera. (6) A series of rapid cuts show her looking at a white piece of paper. Massive white text with black outlines scrolls vertically across the screen, obscuring much of the background. (7) The woman holds the paper and looks directly at the camera, talking and smiling in a well-lit indoor environment with a brick-patterned wallpaper in the background.
